first_reader_said: NEH 12:13: Both records are Meshullam, head of the house of Ezra under Joiakim at 12:13; they differ only in which Ezra they link to.

why: Both records identify the same Meshullam, head of Ezra’s priestly house in Joiakim’s days (NEH 12:12–13). B correctly identifies the ancestral Ezra as the priest who returned with Zerubbabel (NEH 12:1); A’s link to Ezra the scribe is mistaken. NEH 12:33 gives no father or other distinguishing detail requiring a separate person, although its identification with this Meshullam remains uncertain.
